economy:
Ibiceri byo mu mukino gusa. Nta mafaranga nyayo, gukina urusimbi cyangwa kubivunjamo amafaranga.

/earn: ibiceri 10 ku munota
/pay: kohereza ibiceri 1-10000 ubanje kubigenzura
